name: @aburi/github-action
description: GitHub Action wrapper around @aburi/cli: runs `aburi diff` for a pull request, uploads the semantic diff Markdown as a PR comment (upserted by a hidden marker), and forwards `--fail-on` so CI gates fire off Aburi's status/count clauses. Composite action; the CLI is either fetched with `pnpm dlx @aburi/cli@<version>`, so consumers pin the CLI rather than this wrapper, or taken from the project's own install (`cli: workspace`), which is what lets a config name its plugins by package.
author: kage1020
